we know.

You've immortalized beautiful memories for us that we will treasure for a lifetime. A special shoutout to the multi-talented Yadnesh, the driving force behind this wonderful experience.

We extend our heartfelt best wishes to you for all your future endeavors.

To all the couples and individuals currently considering a photographer, reading this review – hesitate no more and choose Fatty's Photography. You will undoubtedly not regret it.

featured_reviews.name: Tejasvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
On 31st March, during my engagement, I had a very good experience with CamLens Photography & Films
However, I got raw photos without any editing or filters—it was so raw that I could have clicked similar pictures with my mobile. For the videos, I had to explain over a hundred times the type of edited video I wanted, but even after all that, the final edited video left me unsatisfied.
When we later started discussing our wedding packages, we mentioned that last time we didn’t ask for a discount but expected one this time. At that point, he began arguing, saying that he had given us a fair price and package last time, and went on about how busy he was and the number of shoots he had on our engagement day. We had only asked for a good discount this time, but he started justifying the packages he gave us last time instead of focusing on our wedding package that we asked him for.
Like this is way you talk to you client l??
Don't tell us how much work quantity you have show us your quality work
Just because you have so many shoots so client has to tell you 100 times that how they need their photo and videos
Stop getting obsessed with yourself and concentrate on quality and give quality results to clients
